purpose: Similarity-first capability extension for the N07 Octacore fusion. Source agents and tools remain external provenance; no ownership transfer or source-code copy is implied.

skill_acquisition.role: tool/skill acquisition and capability expansion candidate generation

agent_workflow.role: multi-agent task decomposition, queueing and tool execution patterns

tool_manager.role: tool registry/selection patterns for federated capability composition

integration_rule: Only a capability exposed by a real target runtime may become REAL; similarity alone never creates executable authority.
ci_requirement: Every promoted adapter must have deterministic unit coverage and fail-closed behavior.
